selo.institutoNaoGuarda: Goes through the Institute's server; the Institute does not keep what you sent
selo.institutoConsulta: Goes through the Institute's server, which looks up {servico}; the service consulted does not learn who you are

servicos.dicionarios: Wiktionary (Portuguese), Dicionário Aberto and the Free Dictionary API
servicos.phet: PhET (phet.colorado.edu), which opens inside the page
servicos.vozDoNavegador: the browser's voice; in some browsers it is generated by the browser's company, which receives the text read aloud
servicos.reconhecimentoDeFala: the browser's speech service; in some browsers, what you say is sent to the browser's company
servicos.ia: an AI provider, with servers outside Brazil

qualidade.lead: Counted from the lesson files when the site is built. It shows the state of the content, never a ranking of people.
qualidade.revisadas: Reviewed by someone on the team
qualidade.emRevisaoProntas: Under review, with the full lesson model
qualidade.emRevisaoFaltam: Under review, parts of the lesson model still missing
qualidade.comTeste: With a quiz at the end
qualidade.comExercicio: With corrected exercises that explain each mistake
qualidade.guia: How a lesson is reviewed (review guide)
